request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and resonant, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, soft percussion, solemn and reflective, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
David sorted the priests in order
The sixteenth line was given to Immer
In the temple they kept the watch
Serving the God of the house

[Chorus]
Pashhur son of the priest
Heard the prophet speak the words
Beaten and bound in the stocks
At the Upper Benjamin Gate

[Verse]
Exile ended and they came home
A thousand and fifty-two returned
The sons of Immer walked back
To the city of the Lord

[Chorus]
Pashhur son of the priest
Heard the prophet speak the words
Beaten and bound in the stocks
At the Upper Benjamin Gate

[Bridge]
Morning light broke the silence
Jeremiah spoke his truth
The name meant terror he said
On every single side

[Outro]
The line endured through the years
Faithful to the temple ground
